summary.text: Nikil Saval is a Democrat who represents Pennsylvania's 1st Senatorial District in Philadelphia, where he is Democratic chair of the Senate Urban Affairs & Housing Committee and chair of the Senate's Philadelphia Delegation.

paragraphs.text: Saval was born in 1982 to parents who immigrated from Bangalore, India, and who opened a pizza restaurant that year in which he spent much of his childhood and adolescence. He began as a labor organizer and a writer, publishing in The New York Times and The New Yorker, co-editing the literary journal n+1, and publishing the 2014 book Cubed: A Secret History of the Workplace.

In the Senate his biography highlights the Whole-Home Repairs Program for home repairs and weatherization in each county. He lives in South Philadelphia with his wife, Shannon Garrison, and their two sons.
